verdict.rationale: Kintsugi exposes REST endpoints to retrieve filings, nexus, exemptions, and transaction records (e.g. Get Filings, Get Nexus, Create Exemption) which technically let a user pull their data in JSON via the API, but there is no documented bulk 'export all data' feature, no explicit open-format export tool, and no guidance on closing/exiting the platform with a full data dump. Missing for 10: a dedicated data-export/download feature, documentation of a full-account export format, and any mention of an offboarding/exit data process.
